title: Static-first MSP Automation Hub
problem: MSP teams needed a reliable way to launch automation runbooks without maintaining servers.
architecture: Azure Static Web Apps front-end, Azure Functions for secure API triggers, GitHub Actions for CI/CD.
tradeoffs: Chose static delivery for reliability and cost; deferred database until telemetry proved the need.

title: Operations Observability Dashboard
problem: Support leads lacked visibility into automation health across tenants.
architecture: Streamlit UI backed by API aggregations; logs centralized via structured JSON events.
tradeoffs: Accepted nightly batch updates initially to ship faster; moving toward event-driven feeds.

title: Identity-driven On/Offboarding
problem: New hires and leavers required consistent identity + device actions across vendors.
architecture: n8n orchestrations calling Microsoft Graph, MDM, and ticket APIs with guardrails.
tradeoffs: Balanced speed and safety using scoped credentials and staged rollouts.
